SELECT tmp1.equMark, tmp1.indentifyMark, tmp1.registBankCode, IFNULL(tmp1.fundAccPlace,tmp2.fundAccPlace) fundAccPlace, IFNULL(tmp1.theBankCode,tmp2.agencyCode) agencyCode, tmp2.orgIndentifyMark FROM( SELECT 'SUB' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_SUB WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CHECK' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL ) tmp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT(ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK) as orgIndentifyMark, INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, FUND_ACC_PLACE as fundAccPlace, IFNULL(AGENCY_CODE,REGIST_BANK_CODE) as agencyCode FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) >= #{lastRepairTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) tmp2 ON tmp1.indentifyMark = tmp2.orgIndentifyMark

SELECT 'SUB' equMark, indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark FROM （ SELECT indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by tmp.indentifyMark order by tmp.tableNo,tmp.UPDATE_TIME desc ) indMarkNo FROM（ SELECT '02' tableNo, B.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, B.REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, B.THE_BANK_CODE agencyCode, B.INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, B.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( select * from CHB_EQU_SUB where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS = '02' and ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK is null and (FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL) ) A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK
UNION ALL
SELECT '01' tableNo, D.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, D.REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, D.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, D.THE_BANK_CODE agencyCode, D.INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, D.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( select * from CHB_EQU_SUB where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS = '02' and ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK is null and (FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL) ) C LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_HIS D on C.INDENTIFY_MARK = D.INDENTIFY_MARK ） tmp ) WHERE indMarkNo = '2'

SELECT 'SUB' equMark, indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark FROM ( SELECT indentifyMark, registBankCode, fundAccPlace, agencyCode, orgIndentifyMark, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by tmp.indentifyMark ,tmp.orgMark order by tmp.tableNo desc,tmp.UPDATE_TIME desc ) indMarkNo FROM ( ----从SUB表查询相关记录 SELECT '02' tableNo, A.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, A.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK orgMark, A.REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, B.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, B.THE_BANK_CODE agencyCode, A.INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, B.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( select * from CHB_EQU_SUB where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TYPE = '02' ) A LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_SUB B on A.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK
UNION ALL
------从HIS表查询相关记录 SELECT '01' tableNo, E.INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, E.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK orgMark, E.REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode, F.FUND_ACC_PLACE fundAccPlace, F.THE_BANK_CODE agencyCode, E.INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, F.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( select * from CHB_EQU_SUB where IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d')) = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TYPE = '02' ) E LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD_HIS F on E.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK = F.INDENTIFY_MARK ) tmp ) WHERE indMarkNo = '2'
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) >= #{lastRepairTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
